newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - May 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - May 22.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Fidel Ramos asserts the Philippine claim to the Scarborough shoal in the South China Sea, despite a claim by China. (ALL PAPERS)
- President Fidel Ramos says initial indicators point to a robust economy in the first quarter this year despite the current slump in the stock market. (PHILIPPINE DAILY INQUIRER)
- President Fidel Ramos says the Palace is not behind the campaign to link Manila Archbishop Jaime Cardinal Sin with the near-collapse of Monte de Piedad & Savings Bank. (MANILA TIMES)
- The Pacific Basin Economic Council ends its session without arriving at a consensus on the proposed financial services agreement. (MANILA TIMES)
- The Securities and Exchange Commission prohibits stock traders and salesmen for their own personal account. (ALL PAPERS)
- The House committee on banks andifnical intermediaries will investigate the recent crash of the local stock market. (PHILIPPINE STAR)
- Proton Pilipinas Corp will export Proton Wira cars to Mexico and Panama by the first quarter of 1998 as part of its efforts to increase its sales by at least $140 million a year. (BUSINESS DAILY)
